_comment: Fictional example. This is the machine-readable half of the voice: exactly what lint-voz.mjs enforces. The voice interview writes this file for you — do not hand-write it unless you want to.
rules: oral, the way I talk. contractions, short sentences
one light human imperfection per message is fine, it sounds like me
close with one open question worth answering
diagnostic tone: someone who noticed a detail, not a seller asking for time
